selection_rule: Within the October 2026 GUDID monthly release (21 daily deltas, ~40k device records), keep every record whose companyName matches one of the five target firms (cap 70 records/firm) and every record whose brand or description matches a product-family keyword (monitoring / respiratory support / imaging / life support / neonatal), total cap 320.
coverage_limit: This is a one-month delta of GUDID changes, not the full GUDID universe (which is published as a ~multi-hundred-MB full release, outside this budget). Row counts here are a sample, never a coverage statement.
